description: Send the site a signed test ping through Mapled's publish webhook, as "Send test ping" in Mapled → Integrations → Your site does, and see at once whether the site took it — the check after configure_revalidation, after MAPLED_WEBHOOK_SECRET is put on the host and after a redeploy. The ping carries no content and goes only where the webhook points; it shows under Recent deliveries in Mapled. The answer: delivered (true once the site answered 2xx), responseStatus (the site's HTTP status, null when nothing came back), reason (blocked, timeout or unreachable when nothing came back) and next, the step that fixes a failed ping. Only an owner's connection can send it.
name: send_test_ping
